/-
Investigation only: replace emitted ordinary MAY/ANY initials with STAR.
No implementation or semantic selection follows from this model.

Scope: FULL scalar marks, ordinary bases, ANY demands, Empty E, all accessors
counted fields, restricted runs >=2. Current budgeted scalar emission is reused.
A direction filter models backward MUST rejection. ANY-demand cells do not use
the imported run-2 STAR-demand override. Static/GROUP/ND/aliases/mx/H and nonempty
E require separate native adapters. ZERO is a separate typed token, not base 0.

The image proof has constructive current-emitter witnesses. C5 below models its
entry image+insideDemand gate and FLOW EXACT normalized preimage, not complete
exit restriction, matching, state transition, convergence or global soundness.
-/
import RestrictedInitialPolicy

namespace MayInitialToStarAudit
open ApSpec
abbrev Input := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Input
abbrev Mark := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Mark

inductive Direction where | forward | backward
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Layer where | normal | demand
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Mode where
  direction : Direction
  fieldLimit : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure AnyDemand where
  base : Nat
  path : List Acc
  mark : Mark
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def asDemand (d : AnyDemand) : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand :=
  ⟨d.base,d.path,.any,d.mark⟩
def directionLegal (direction : Direction) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  match direction with | .forward => true | .backward => !initial.must

def currentEmit (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (actual : Input) : Option Input :=
  match RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emitAtBudget mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) actual with
  | none => none
  | some initial => if directionLegal mode.direction initial then some initial else none

def currentCanEmit (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.canEmitAtBudget mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) initial &&
    directionLegal mode.direction initial

theorem ANY_demand_never_uses_STAR_demand_override (d : AnyDemand) (actual : Input) :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.overrideStar (asDemand d) actual = false := by
  simp [RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.overrideStar,asDemand,
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq]

theorem current_image_has_constructive_actual_witness (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand)
    (initial : Input) :
    currentCanEmit mode d initial = true ↔ ∃ actual, currentEmit mode d actual = some initial := by
  constructor
  · intro allowed
    obtain ⟨image,legal⟩ := (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp allowed
    obtain ⟨actual,emitted⟩ :=
      (RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.bounded_image_has_executable_witness
        mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) initial).mp image
    exact ⟨actual,by simp only [currentEmit,emitted,legal,if_true]⟩
  · rintro ⟨actual,emitted⟩
    cases raw : RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emitAtBudget mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) actual with
    | none => simp only [currentEmit,raw] at emitted; cases emitted
    | some candidate =>
      cases legal : directionLegal mode.direction candidate with
      | false => simp only [currentEmit,raw,legal,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false] at emitted; cases emitted
      | true =>
        have same : candidate = initial := by
          simpa only [currentEmit,raw,legal,if_true,Option.some.injEq] using emitted
        subst initial
        exact (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mpr
          ⟨(RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.bounded_image_has_executable_witness
            mode.fieldLimit (asDemand d) candidate).mpr ⟨actual,raw⟩,legal⟩

/-- ANY with must=false is MAY. MUST is shape ANY with must=true and is unchanged. -/
def replaceMay (initial : Input) : Input :=
  match initial.shape, initial.must with
  | .any, false => { initial with shape := .star }
  | _, _ => initial

def isMay (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq initial.shape .any && !initial.must

/-- Exact finite inverse list of replacement. It is not self-projection. -/
def replacementPreimages (initial : Input) : List Input :=
  match initial.shape, initial.must with
  | .any, false => []
  | .star, false => [initial,{ initial with shape := .any }]
  | _, _ => [initial]

theorem replacement_has_explicit_preimage (initial : Input) :
    initial ∈ replacementPreimages (replaceMay initial) := by
  cases initial with
  | mk base path shape mark must =>
    cases shape <;> cases must <;> simp [replaceMay,replacementPreimages]

theorem every_listed_preimage_replaces_to_target (candidate initial : Input)
    (member : candidate ∈ replacementPreimages initial) : replaceMay candidate = initial := by
  cases initial with
  | mk base path shape mark must =>
    cases shape <;> cases must <;> simp [replacementPreimages] at member
    all_goals first
      | (subst candidate; rfl)
      | (rcases member with same | same <;> cases same <;> rfl)

def chooseCurrent (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) : List Input → Bool
  | [] => false
  | initial :: rest => currentCanEmit mode d initial || chooseCurrent mode d rest

theorem choose_current_iff_explicit_candidate (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (values : List Input) :
    chooseCurrent mode d values = true ↔
      ∃ candidate, candidate ∈ values ∧ currentCanEmit mode d candidate = true := by
  induction values with
  | nil => simp [chooseCurrent]
  | cons head rest ih =>
    constructor
    · intro chosen
      change (currentCanEmit mode d head || chooseCurrent mode d rest) = true at chosen
      cases (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mp chosen with
      | inl accepted => exact ⟨head,by simp,accepted⟩
      | inr accepted =>
        obtain ⟨candidate,member,image⟩ := ih.mp accepted
        exact ⟨candidate,List.mem_cons_of_mem head member,image⟩
    · rintro ⟨candidate,member,accepted⟩
      change (currentCanEmit mode d head || chooseCurrent mode d rest) = true
      cases List.mem_cons.mp member with
      | inl same =>
        subst candidate
        exact (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mpr (Or.inl accepted)
      | inr member =>
        exact (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mpr (Or.inr (ih.mpr ⟨candidate,member,accepted⟩))

def candidateEmit (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (actual : Input) : Option Input :=
  (currentEmit mode d actual).map replaceMay

def candidateCanEmit (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  chooseCurrent mode d (replacementPreimages initial)

/-- Complete output image of the candidate, with a current native-model actual
witness for each accepted initial. No hypothetical initial is interned. -/
theorem candidate_image_exactly_matches_emission (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand)
    (initial : Input) :
    candidateCanEmit mode d initial = true ↔ ∃ actual, candidateEmit mode d actual = some initial := by
  constructor
  · intro allowed
    obtain ⟨raw,member,oldImage⟩ := (choose_current_iff_explicit_candidate mode d _).mp allowed
    obtain ⟨actual,emitted⟩ := (current_image_has_constructive_actual_witness mode d raw).mp oldImage
    exact ⟨actual,by simp only [candidateEmit,emitted,Option.map_some,
      every_listed_preimage_replaces_to_target raw initial member]⟩
  · rintro ⟨actual,emitted⟩
    cases old : currentEmit mode d actual with
    | none => simp only [candidateEmit,old,Option.map_none] at emitted; cases emitted
    | some raw =>
      have same : replaceMay raw = initial := by
        simpa only [candidateEmit,old,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] using emitted
      apply (choose_current_iff_explicit_candidate mode d _).mpr
      refine ⟨raw,?_,(current_image_has_constructive_actual_witness mode d raw).mpr ⟨actual,old⟩⟩
      rw [← same]
      exact replacement_has_explicit_preimage raw

theorem replacement_removes_only_MAY_head (initial : Input) :
    isMay (replaceMay initial) = false := by
  cases initial with
  | mk base path shape mark must =>
    cases shape <;> cases must <;> rfl

theorem replacement_keeps_base_path_mark (initial : Input) :
    (replaceMay initial).base = initial.base ∧
    (replaceMay initial).path = initial.path ∧
    (replaceMay initial).mark = initial.mark := by
  cases initial with
  | mk base path shape mark must =>
    cases shape <;> cases must <;> exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

/-- Empty-E ANY-demand containment only. It is not arbitrary native matching. -/
def insideAny (d : AnyDemand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  Nat.beq d.base initial.base && RestrictedInitialPolicy.acceptsMark d.mark initial.mark &&
    (dropPrefix d.path initial.path).isSome

def flowStar (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  match initial.mark,initial.shape,initial.must with | .flow,.star,false => true | _,_,_ => false

def asExact (initial : Input) : Input := { initial with shape := .exact,must := false }

def canStoreUsing (image : Mode → AnyDemand → Input → Bool) (mode : Mode)
    (d : AnyDemand) (stored : Input) : Bool :=
  let fits := fun raw => image mode d raw && insideAny d raw
  fits stored || (flowStar stored && fits (asExact stored))

def normalizeFlowKey (initial : Input) : Input :=
  match initial.mark,initial.shape with
  | .flow,.exact => { initial with shape := .star }
  | _,_ => initial

structure StoredRow where
  initial : Input
  opaqueExit : Nat
  layer : Layer
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def c5EntryTicket (image : Mode → AnyDemand → Input → Bool) (mode : Mode)
    (d : AnyDemand) (row : StoredRow) : Option StoredRow :=
  if canStoreUsing image mode d row.initial then some row else none

theorem accepted_entry_ticket_preserves_exit_and_layer
    (image : Mode → AnyDemand → Input → Bool) (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand)
    (row selected : StoredRow) (accepted : c5EntryTicket image mode d row = some selected) :
    selected = row := by
  cases gate : canStoreUsing image mode d row.initial with
  | false => simp only [c5EntryTicket,gate,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false] at accepted; cases accepted
  | true => simpa only [c5EntryTicket,gate,if_true,Option.some.injEq] using accepted.symm

def layerOr : Layer → Layer → Layer
  | .normal,.normal => .normal
  | _,_ => .demand

def intrinsic (initial : Input) : Layer :=
  match initial.shape,initial.mark with
  | .any,_ => if initial.must then .normal else .demand
  | .star,.full _ => .demand
  | _,_ => .normal

/-- The current concrete support/loss-bit rule. Recalculation is NOT a blanket
intrinsic-only reset; existing EXACT-on-MAY demotion remains present. -/
def admissionLayer (emitted actual : Input) (supplied : Layer) : Layer :=
  match emitted.mark with
  | .flow => intrinsic emitted
  | .full _ => layerOr (intrinsic emitted)
      (if decide (supplied = .demand) || (RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq emitted.shape .exact && isMay actual)
       then .demand else .normal)

def startLayer (initial : Input) (admitted : Layer) : Layer :=
  layerOr (intrinsic initial) admitted

inductive LayerChoice where | preserveAdmission | recalculateConverted
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def candidateStart (choice : LayerChoice) (old actual : Input) (supplied : Layer) : Layer :=
  let next := replaceMay old
  if isMay old then
    match choice with
    | .preserveAdmission => startLayer next (admissionLayer old actual supplied)
    | .recalculateConverted => startLayer next (admissionLayer next actual supplied)
  else startLayer old (admissionLayer old actual supplied)

/-- Necessary existing target guards after matching. This does not establish
that a relation matched, a concrete source arrived or a target was published. -/
def normalTargetGuard (direction : Direction) (flowOrigin : Bool)
    (matched offered : Layer) : Bool :=
  decide (direction = .forward) && !flowOrigin && decide (layerOr matched offered = .normal)

/-- Tail/layer part of the existing MAY-prefix certificate guard. A failed
certificate does not mean the native fallback or its result is absent. -/
def mayCertificate (expected : List Acc) (initial : Input) (layer : Layer) : Bool :=
  decide (initial.path = expected) && isMay initial && decide (layer = .demand)

/-- ZERO is a typed token outside the ordinary ANY-demand data grammar. -/
inductive TypedInput where | zero | ordinary (fact : Input)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def replaceTyped : TypedInput → TypedInput
  | .zero => .zero
  | .ordinary initial => .ordinary (replaceMay initial)
def emitTyped (mode : Mode) (d : AnyDemand) : TypedInput → Option TypedInput
  | .zero => none
  | .ordinary actual => (candidateEmit mode d actual).map TypedInput.ordinary

/-- Suffix relation of the copied start fact. It is a local relation abstraction
for ordinary return/copy, not a native driver or all-summary correctness proof. -/
def copiedStart (initial : Input) (resultBase : Nat) : Input := { initial with base := resultBase }
def premiseAllowsSuffix (_initial : Input) (_suffix : List Acc) : Bool := true
def copyRelationAllows (initial : Input) (inputSuffix outputSuffix : List Acc) : Bool :=
  if isMay initial then true else decide (inputSuffix = outputSuffix)

def starSuffixTransfer (entry : Input) (resultBase : Nat) (actual : Input) : Option Input :=
  if Nat.beq entry.base actual.base then
    (dropPrefix entry.path actual.path).map (fun suffix => {actual with base := resultBase,path := suffix})
  else none

theorem STAR_copy_transports_exact_T_suffix (base resultBase : Nat) (path suffix : List Acc) (t : Nat) :
    starSuffixTransfer ⟨base,path,.star,.flow,false⟩ resultBase
      ⟨base,path ++ suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩ =
      some ⟨resultBase,suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩ := by
  have removedPrefix : dropPrefix path (path ++ suffix) = some suffix := CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
  simp only [starSuffixTransfer,Nat.beq_refl,if_true,removedPrefix,Option.map_some]

def forward2 : Mode := ⟨.forward,2⟩
def backward2 : Mode := ⟨.backward,2⟩
def forward1 : Mode := ⟨.forward,1⟩
def p : Nat := 1
def ret : Nat := 2
def f : Acc := 7
def g : Acc := 8
def T : Mark := .full 11
def d0 (mark : Mark) : AnyDemand := ⟨p,[],mark⟩
def d1 (mark : Mark) : AnyDemand := ⟨p,[f],mark⟩
def atF (mark : Mark) : Input := ⟨p,[f],.any,mark,false⟩
def starF (mark : Mark) : Input := ⟨p,[f],.star,mark,false⟩

theorem the_two_current_ANY_result_cells_and_replacements :
    currentEmit forward2 (d1 .flow) (atF T) = some (atF .flow) ∧
    currentEmit forward2 (d1 .flow) ⟨p,[],.any,T,false⟩ = some (atF .flow) ∧
    candidateEmit forward2 (d1 .flow) (atF T) = some (starF .flow) ∧
    candidateEmit forward2 (d1 .flow) ⟨p,[],.any,T,false⟩ = some (starF .flow) ∧
    candidateEmit backward2 (d1 T) (atF T) = some (starF T) := by decide

theorem same_head_STAR_needs_a_new_image_classifier :
    currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = false ∧
    candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = true ∧
    currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = false ∧
    candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = true ∧
    candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (atF T) = false := by decide

theorem supplied_STAR_still_rejects_and_self_projection_is_incomplete :
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = none ∧
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = none ∧
    candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = true := by decide

theorem old_C5_FLOW_normalized_EXACT_fallback_is_not_concrete_STAR_admission :
    normalizeFlowKey ⟨p,[f],.exact,.flow,false⟩ = starF .flow ∧
    canStoreUsing currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = true ∧
    canStoreUsing currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = false ∧
    canStoreUsing candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) = true := by decide

theorem finer_field_and_terminal_exact_cells_are_unchanged :
    currentEmit forward2 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ =
      candidateEmit forward2 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ ∧
    candidateEmit forward2 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ = some ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ ∧
    candidateEmit forward2 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f,g],.exact,T,false⟩ = some (starF T) ∧
    candidateEmit forward1 (d0 T) ⟨p,[f,g],.exact,T,false⟩ = none := by decide

theorem same_head_conversion_needs_no_new_field_budget :
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (atF T) = some (starF .flow) ∧
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 T) (atF T) = some (starF T) ∧
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 T) ⟨p,[f,g],.exact,T,false⟩ = none := by decide

theorem MUST_is_not_replaced_and_backward_still_forbids_it :
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 T) ⟨p,[f],.any,T,true⟩ = some ⟨p,[f],.any,T,true⟩ ∧
    candidateEmit backward2 (d1 T) ⟨p,[f],.any,T,true⟩ = none ∧
    replaceMay ⟨p,[f],.any,.flow,true⟩ = ⟨p,[f],.any,.flow,true⟩ := by decide

theorem FLOW_recalculation_promotes_but_explicit_DEMAND_preservation_does_not :
    intrinsic (atF .flow) = .demand ∧ intrinsic (starF .flow) = .normal ∧
    candidateStart .preserveAdmission (atF .flow) (atF T) .demand = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .recalculateConverted (atF .flow) (atF T) .demand = .normal ∧
    candidateStart .preserveAdmission (atF T) (atF T) .demand = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .recalculateConverted (atF T) (atF T) .demand = .demand := by decide

theorem unrelated_EXACT_on_MAY_loss_bit_is_not_erased :
    admissionLayer ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ (atF T) .normal = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .recalculateConverted ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ (atF T) .normal = .demand := by decide

theorem FLOW_or_DEMAND_target_guards_prevent_an_immediate_spurious_NORMAL_claim :
    normalTargetGuard .forward true .normal .normal = false ∧
    normalTargetGuard .forward false .demand .normal = false ∧
    normalTargetGuard .forward false .normal .demand = false ∧
    normalTargetGuard .backward false .normal .normal = false ∧
    normalTargetGuard .forward false .normal .normal = true := by decide

theorem both_layer_choices_fail_the_existing_MAY_certificate_tail_guard :
    mayCertificate [f] (atF .flow) .demand = true ∧
    mayCertificate [f] (starF .flow) .demand = false ∧
    mayCertificate [f] (starF .flow) .normal = false := by decide

theorem ZERO_is_excluded_from_the_ordinary_ANY_candidate :
    replaceTyped .zero = .zero ∧ emitTyped forward2 (d0 .flow) .zero = none := by decide

theorem equal_premise_domains_do_not_imply_equal_copied_summary_relations :
    premiseAllowsSuffix (atF .flow) [f] = premiseAllowsSuffix (starF .flow) [f] ∧
    copiedStart (atF .flow) ret = ⟨ret,[f],.any,.flow,false⟩ ∧
    copiedStart (starF .flow) ret = ⟨ret,[f],.star,.flow,false⟩ ∧
    copyRelationAllows (atF .flow) [f] [g] = true ∧
    copyRelationAllows (starF .flow) [f] [g] = false ∧
    copyRelationAllows (starF .flow) [f] [f] = true := by decide

/-- Conditional header-cost abstraction only. It assumes an already protected
MAY or STAR root after the primer and models the supplied strong-write E step.
No AP/runtime/owner enabling, scheduling or cost measurement is inferred. -/
inductive ProtectedHead where | may | star
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def strongWriteHeader (head : ProtectedHead) (e : List Acc) (field : Acc) : List Acc :=
  match head with | .may => [] | .star => e ++ [field]
def optionalHeader (head : ProtectedHead) (current : List (List Acc)) (field : Acc) : List (List Acc) :=
  (current ++ current.map (fun e => strongWriteHeader head e field)).eraseDups

def headerStages (head : ProtectedHead) : List (List (List Acc)) :=
  let h0 : List (List Acc) := [[]]
  let h1 := optionalHeader head h0 1
  let h2 := optionalHeader head h1 2
  let h3 := optionalHeader head h2 3
  let h4 := optionalHeader head h3 4
  let h5 := optionalHeader head h4 5
  [h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5]

theorem conditional_literal_H_header_family_is_one_versus_thirty_two :
    (headerStages .may).map List.length = [1,1,1,1,1,1] ∧
    (headerStages .star).map List.length = [1,2,4,8,16,32] ∧
    ((headerStages .star).getLast!).eraseDups.length = 32 := by decide

theorem concrete_STAR_header_family_does_not_require_a_NORMAL_promotion :
    intrinsic (starF T) = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .preserveAdmission (atF T) (atF T) .demand = .demand ∧
    candidateStart .recalculateConverted (atF T) (atF T) .demand = .demand := by decide

def check : Bool :=
  candidateCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) &&
  !currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) &&
  canStoreUsing currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) &&
  !canStoreUsing currentCanEmit forward1 (d1 T) (starF T) &&
  decide (candidateStart .recalculateConverted (atF .flow) (atF T) .demand = .normal) &&
  !mayCertificate [f] (starF .flow) .demand

theorem executable_investigation_cells : check = true := by decide
#eval (if check then "MAY_INITIAL_TO_STAR_AUDIT=true" else "MAY_INITIAL_TO_STAR_AUDIT=false")

/-
SELECTED FULL strategy: post-map every emitted MAY/ANY initial to STAR.
Joint image supplement. No new source, grounding, history or admission cell.

The exact executable image is finite: two ordinary bases, a two-field alphabet,
all paths of length <=2, FLOW/two full marks, all valid tails and supplied layers.
MAY actuals are DEMAND by W6. Other actuals keep supplied N/D support. The generic
joint-image theorem is parameterized by the CURRENT scalar emitter; instantiating
it does not add an emitter rule. The certificate theorem uses the checked ANY-
demand scalar adapter universally over counted-field paths and full scalar marks.
Static/GROUP/mx/nonemptyE/noncounted accessors and native owner loops are OPEN.
-/
import MayInitialToStarAuditRootChecked

namespace SelectedFullAdmission
open ApSpec MayInitialToStarAudit
abbrev Mark := MayInitialToStarAudit.Mark
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

structure Actual where
  fact : Input
  layer : Layer
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Admission where
  initial : Input
  layer : Layer
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Re-run the current support rule on the converted shape. This changes FLOW
MAY/D to STAR/N; concrete STAR stays D. It is not an intrinsic-only reset. -/
def convertAdmission (old : Input) (actual : Actual) : Admission :=
  let initial := replaceMay old
  ⟨initial,admissionLayer initial actual.fact actual.layer⟩
def emitJoint (oldEmitter : Input → Option Input) (actual : Actual) : Option Admission :=
  (oldEmitter actual.fact).map (fun old => convertAdmission old actual)

def anyBy {α : Type} (accept : α → Bool) : List α → Bool
  | [] => false
  | x :: xs => accept x || anyBy accept xs

theorem finite_search_has_explicit_witness {α : Type} (accept : α → Bool) (xs : List α) :
    anyBy accept xs = true ↔ ∃ x, x ∈ xs ∧ accept x = true := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [anyBy]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    constructor
    · intro yes
      change (accept x || anyBy accept xs) = true at yes
      cases (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mp yes with
      | inl h => exact ⟨x,by simp,h⟩
      | inr h =>
        obtain ⟨y,member,accepted⟩ := ih.mp h
        exact ⟨y,List.mem_cons_of_mem x member,accepted⟩
    · rintro ⟨y,member,accepted⟩
      change (accept x || anyBy accept xs) = true
      cases List.mem_cons.mp member with
      | inl same => subst y; exact (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mpr (Or.inl accepted)
      | inr member => exact (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mpr (Or.inr (ih.mpr ⟨y,member,accepted⟩))

inductive BaseTag where | first | second
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive PathTag where | root | f | g | ff | fg | gf | gg
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive TailTag where | exact | star | may | must
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive MarkTag where | flow | t | u
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure ActualTag where
  base : BaseTag
  path : PathTag
  tail : TailTag
  mark : MarkTag
  support : Layer
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def baseOf : BaseTag → Nat | .first => 1 | .second => 2
def pathOf : PathTag → List Acc
  | .root => [] | .f => [7] | .g => [8] | .ff => [7,7]
  | .fg => [7,8] | .gf => [8,7] | .gg => [8,8]
def markOf : MarkTag → Mark | .flow => .flow | .t => .full 11 | .u => .full 12

def actualOf (tag : ActualTag) : Actual :=
  let shape : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Shape :=
    match tag.tail with
    | .exact => .exact
    | .star => .star
    | .may => .any
    | .must => .any
  ⟨⟨baseOf tag.base,pathOf tag.path,shape,markOf tag.mark,
      match tag.tail with | .must => true | _ => false⟩,
    match tag.tail with | .may => .demand | _ => tag.support⟩

def allActualTags : List ActualTag :=
  [BaseTag.first,.second].flatMap fun b =>
  [PathTag.root,.f,.g,.ff,.fg,.gf,.gg].flatMap fun p =>
  [TailTag.exact,.star,.may,.must].flatMap fun t =>
  [MarkTag.flow,.t,.u].flatMap fun m =>
  [Layer.normal,.demand].map fun l => ⟨b,p,t,m,l⟩

theorem every_bounded_typed_actual_is_enumerated (tag : ActualTag) : tag ∈ allActualTags := by
  cases tag with
  | mk b p t m l =>
    unfold allActualTags
    apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    refine ⟨b,?_,?_⟩
    · cases b <;> simp
    · apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
      refine ⟨p,?_,?_⟩
      · cases p <;> simp
      · apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
        refine ⟨t,?_,?_⟩
        · cases t <;> simp
        · apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
          refine ⟨m,?_,?_⟩
          · cases m <;> simp
          · apply List.mem_map.mpr
            exact ⟨l,by cases l <;> simp,rfl⟩

/-- The inverse has at most two PATTERN preimages. The remaining predicate
checks the actual supplied layer/loss support; it is not guessed from a key. -/
def inverseJointCell (oldEmitter : Input → Option Input) (wanted : Admission) (actual : Actual) : Bool :=
  anyBy (fun raw => decide (oldEmitter actual.fact = some raw) &&
    decide (admissionLayer wanted.initial actual.fact actual.layer = wanted.layer))
    (replacementPreimages wanted.initial)

theorem inverse_joint_cell_exactly_matches_emission
    (oldEmitter : Input → Option Input) (wanted : Admission) (actual : Actual) :
    inverseJointCell oldEmitter wanted actual = true ↔ emitJoint oldEmitter actual = some wanted := by
  rw [inverseJointCell,finite_search_has_explicit_witness]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨raw,member,accepted⟩
    obtain ⟨emitted,layer⟩ := (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp accepted
    have rawEquation : oldEmitter actual.fact = some raw := of_decide_eq_true emitted
    have layerEquation : admissionLayer wanted.initial actual.fact actual.layer = wanted.layer :=
      of_decide_eq_true layer
    have initialEquation := every_listed_preimage_replaces_to_target raw wanted.initial member
    cases wanted with
    | mk initial selectedLayer =>
      simp only [emitJoint,rawEquation,Option.map_some,convertAdmission,initialEquation,layerEquation]
  · intro emitted
    cases rawEquation : oldEmitter actual.fact with
    | none => simp only [emitJoint,rawEquation,Option.map_none] at emitted; cases emitted
    | some raw =>
      have same : convertAdmission raw actual = wanted := by
        simpa only [emitJoint,rawEquation,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] using emitted
      rw [← same]
      exact ⟨raw,replacement_has_explicit_preimage raw,
        (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mpr ⟨decide_eq_true rfl,decide_eq_true rfl⟩⟩

def canEmitJoint (oldEmitter : Input → Option Input) (wanted : Admission) : Bool :=
  anyBy (fun tag => inverseJointCell oldEmitter wanted (actualOf tag)) allActualTags

/-- Exact joint initial/layer image over the declared COMPLETE bounded actual
universe. The actual tag and its materialized support are executable witnesses. -/
theorem exact_joint_image_has_actual_and_layer_witness
    (oldEmitter : Input → Option Input) (wanted : Admission) :
    canEmitJoint oldEmitter wanted = true ↔
      ∃ tag : ActualTag, emitJoint oldEmitter (actualOf tag) = some wanted := by
  rw [canEmitJoint,finite_search_has_explicit_witness]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨tag,_,accepted⟩
    exact ⟨tag,(inverse_joint_cell_exactly_matches_emission oldEmitter wanted _).mp accepted⟩
  · rintro ⟨tag,emitted⟩
    exact ⟨tag,every_bounded_typed_actual_is_enumerated tag,
      (inverse_joint_cell_exactly_matches_emission oldEmitter wanted _).mpr emitted⟩

theorem non_MAY_output_preserves_current_support
    (old : Input) (actual : Actual) (notMay : isMay old = false) :
    convertAdmission old actual = ⟨old,admissionLayer old actual.fact actual.layer⟩ := by
  cases old with
  | mk b p s m must =>
    cases s <;> cases must <;> simp [isMay,RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq] at notMay
    all_goals rfl

theorem selected_layer_and_unrelated_EXACT_loss_cells :
    convertAdmission (atF .flow) ⟨atF T,.demand⟩ = ⟨starF .flow,.normal⟩ ∧
    convertAdmission (atF T) ⟨atF T,.demand⟩ = ⟨starF T,.demand⟩ ∧
    convertAdmission ⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩ ⟨atF T,.normal⟩ =
      ⟨⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩,.demand⟩ ∧
    convertAdmission ⟨p,[f],.any,T,true⟩ ⟨⟨p,[f],.any,T,true⟩,.demand⟩ =
      ⟨⟨p,[f],.any,T,true⟩,.demand⟩ := by decide

def mayAt (b : Nat) (path : List Acc) (m : Mark) : Input := ⟨b,path,.any,m,false⟩
def starAt (b : Nat) (path : List Acc) (m : Mark) : Input := ⟨b,path,.star,m,false⟩
def starLayer : Mark → Layer | .flow => .normal | .full _ => .demand

/-- Both native MAY-result cells, with the full witness path and unchanged mark
matching/budget. An earlier cut need not be exactly one field from the witness. -/
theorem current_MAY_prefixes_emit_the_same_witness
    (mode : Mode) (b : Nat) (prefixPath suffix : List Acc) (required supplied : Mark)
    (markMatches : RestrictedInitialPolicy.acceptsMark required supplied = true)
    (budget : (prefixPath ++ suffix).length ≤ mode.fieldLimit) :
    currentEmit mode ⟨b,prefixPath ++ suffix,required⟩ (mayAt b prefixPath supplied) =
      some (mayAt b (prefixPath ++ suffix) required) := by
  have prefixFits : prefixPath.length ≤ mode.fieldLimit := by
    simp only [List.length_append] at budget
    omega
  have ordinary : RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit (asDemand ⟨b,prefixPath ++ suffix,required⟩)
      (mayAt b prefixPath supplied) = some (mayAt b (prefixPath ++ suffix) required) := by
    cases suffix with
    | nil =>
      have same : dropPrefix prefixPath prefixPath = some [] := ApSpec.Handoff.RAux.dropPrefix_self' prefixPath
      simp [RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit,RestrictedInitialPolicy.selectTemplate,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.rawTemplate,RestrictedInitialPolicy.validInput,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.validTemplate,RestrictedInitialPolicy.render,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq,asDemand,mayAt,relate,same,markMatches]
    | cons field rest =>
      have below : dropPrefix prefixPath (prefixPath ++ field :: rest) = some (field :: rest) :=
        CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
      have aboveNone : dropPrefix (prefixPath ++ field :: rest) prefixPath = none := by
        cases h : dropPrefix (prefixPath ++ field :: rest) prefixPath with
        | none => rfl
        | some tail =>
          have equation := CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mp h
          have lengths := congrArg List.length equation
          simp only [List.length_append,List.length_cons] at lengths
          omega
      have relative := CoreAux.relate_above aboveNone below
      simp [RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit,RestrictedInitialPolicy.selectTemplate,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.rawTemplate,RestrictedInitialPolicy.validInput,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.validTemplate,RestrictedInitialPolicy.render,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq,asDemand,mayAt,relative,markMatches]
  have raw : RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emit
      (asDemand ⟨b,prefixPath ++ suffix,required⟩) (mayAt b prefixPath supplied) =
      some (mayAt b (prefixPath ++ suffix) required) := by
    rw [RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.unchanged_outside_override _ _
      (ANY_demand_never_uses_STAR_demand_override _ _)]
    exact ordinary
  have bounded := RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.budget_emission_from_facts
    mode.fieldLimit (asDemand ⟨b,prefixPath ++ suffix,required⟩)
    (mayAt b prefixPath supplied) (mayAt b (prefixPath ++ suffix) required)
    budget prefixFits raw budget
  simp only [currentEmit,bounded]
  cases mode.direction <;> rfl

theorem selected_MAY_prefix_joint_result_is_constant
    (mode : Mode) (b : Nat) (prefixPath suffix : List Acc) (required supplied : Mark)
    (markMatches : RestrictedInitialPolicy.acceptsMark required supplied = true)
    (budget : (prefixPath ++ suffix).length ≤ mode.fieldLimit) :
    emitJoint (currentEmit mode ⟨b,prefixPath ++ suffix,required⟩)
      ⟨mayAt b prefixPath supplied,.demand⟩ =
      some ⟨starAt b (prefixPath ++ suffix) required,starLayer required⟩ := by
  rw [emitJoint,current_MAY_prefixes_emit_the_same_witness mode b prefixPath suffix required supplied markMatches budget]
  cases required <;> rfl

/-- Opaque complete label: it stands for the exact scope/family/original/exit
key, not an invitation to combine distinct labels or physical interfaces. -/
structure Label where
  scope : Nat
  family : Nat
  original : Nat
  exit : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def labelledAnswer (label : Label) (answer : Option Admission) : Option (Label × Admission) :=
  answer.map (fun value => (label,value))

theorem certificate_comparison_keeps_label_and_answer_for_any_earlier_prefix
    (mode : Mode) (b : Nat) (path prefix1 suffix1 prefix2 suffix2 : List Acc)
    (required supplied : Mark) (label : Label)
    (same1 : path = prefix1 ++ suffix1) (same2 : path = prefix2 ++ suffix2)
    (markMatches : RestrictedInitialPolicy.acceptsMark required supplied = true)
    (budget : path.length ≤ mode.fieldLimit) :
    labelledAnswer label (emitJoint (currentEmit mode ⟨b,path,required⟩)
      ⟨mayAt b prefix1 supplied,.demand⟩) =
    labelledAnswer label (emitJoint (currentEmit mode ⟨b,path,required⟩)
      ⟨mayAt b prefix2 supplied,.demand⟩) := by
  have first := selected_MAY_prefix_joint_result_is_constant mode b prefix1 suffix1 required supplied markMatches
    (by simpa only [← same1] using budget)
  have second := selected_MAY_prefix_joint_result_is_constant mode b prefix2 suffix2 required supplied markMatches
    (by simpa only [← same2] using budget)
  rw [← same1] at first
  rw [← same2] at second
  rw [first,second]

def selectedCertificateGuard (witness : AnyDemand) (answer : Admission) : Bool :=
  decide (answer.initial.base = witness.base) && decide (answer.initial.path = witness.path) &&
    decide (answer.initial.mark = witness.mark) &&
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq answer.initial.shape .star && !answer.initial.must &&
    decide (answer.layer = starLayer witness.mark)

theorem adapted_certificate_accepts_exact_selected_witness_only
    (b : Nat) (path : List Acc) (mark : Mark) :
    selectedCertificateGuard ⟨b,path,mark⟩ ⟨starAt b path mark,starLayer mark⟩ = true := by
  cases mark <;> simp [selectedCertificateGuard,starAt,starLayer,RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq]

theorem certificate_negatives_and_old_STAR_actual_rejection :
    selectedCertificateGuard (d1 .flow) ⟨starF .flow,.demand⟩ = false ∧
    selectedCertificateGuard (d1 T) ⟨starF T,.normal⟩ = false ∧
    selectedCertificateGuard (d1 T) ⟨starAt p [g] T,.demand⟩ = false ∧
    candidateEmit forward1 (d1 .flow) (starF .flow) = none := by decide

def check : Bool :=
  canEmitJoint (currentEmit forward1 (d1 .flow)) ⟨starF .flow,.normal⟩ &&
  !canEmitJoint (currentEmit forward1 (d1 .flow)) ⟨starF .flow,.demand⟩ &&
  canEmitJoint (currentEmit forward1 (d1 T)) ⟨starF T,.demand⟩ &&
  !canEmitJoint (currentEmit forward1 (d1 T)) ⟨starF T,.normal⟩ &&
  canEmitJoint (currentEmit forward1 (d1 T)) ⟨⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩,.normal⟩ &&
  canEmitJoint (currentEmit forward1 (d1 T)) ⟨⟨p,[f],.exact,T,false⟩,.demand⟩ &&
  selectedCertificateGuard (d1 .flow) ⟨starF .flow,.normal⟩

theorem executable_selected_full_joint_and_certificate_cells : check = true := by decide
#eval (if check then "SELECTED_FULL_JOINT=true" else "SELECTED_FULL_JOINT=false")

#print axioms finite_search_has_explicit_witness
#print axioms every_bounded_typed_actual_is_enumerated
#print axioms inverse_joint_cell_exactly_matches_emission
#print axioms exact_joint_image_has_actual_and_layer_witness
#print axioms non_MAY_output_preserves_current_support
#print axioms selected_layer_and_unrelated_EXACT_loss_cells
#print axioms current_MAY_prefixes_emit_the_same_witness
#print axioms selected_MAY_prefix_joint_result_is_constant
#print axioms certificate_comparison_keeps_label_and_answer_for_any_earlier_prefix
#print axioms adapted_certificate_accepts_exact_selected_witness_only
#print axioms certificate_negatives_and_old_STAR_actual_rejection
#print axioms executable_selected_full_joint_and_certificate_cells

end SelectedFullAdmission

/-
STAR_OR_ANY investigation/draft adapter. It is decorated STAR, never MUST.
Default C2: retain STAR answer; only a rejected ANY demand tries a virtual MAY
view, gated by ORIGINAL STAR/E reachability. Other interpretations are explicit
comparison parameters, not additional selected admissions.

Ordinary scalar FULL/Empty-demand-E, counted fields; old scalar run/budget guards
are reused. The finite exact image covers the complete672tag ordinary actual
universe (two bases, paths<=2 over f/g, FLOW/T/U, legal tails/layers, decoration).
Current native static/GROUP/mx/full E and mutable-store adapters are OPEN.
Public summary/Target/paired-demand rows erase the marker. Archived scoped
intra-procedural point inputs retain it, even when replayed in a later run.
-/
import SelectedFullAdmissionProofFixed

namespace StarOrAnyDesign
open ApSpec
abbrev Input := MayInitialToStarAudit.Input
abbrev Mark := MayInitialToStarAudit.Mark
abbrev Layer := MayInitialToStarAudit.Layer
abbrev Mode := MayInitialToStarAudit.Mode
abbrev Demand := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand
abbrev OldTag := SelectedFullAdmission.ActualTag
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

inductive PlainHead where | exact | star | may | must
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Head where | plain (tail : PlainHead) | starOrAny
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Pattern where
  base : Nat
  path : List Acc
  head : Head
  mark : Mark
  exclusion : List Acc := []
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Fact where
  pattern : Pattern
  layer : Layer
  protection : Bool := false
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Seed where
  pattern : Pattern
  layer : Layer
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive C2Choice where | starThenMayForAny | mayOnly | unionViews
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def opHead : Head → PlainHead | .plain h => h | .starOrAny => .star
def marked : Head → Bool | .starOrAny => true | _ => false
def plainOf (i : Input) : PlainHead :=
  if i.must then .must else match i.shape with | .exact => .exact | .star => .star | .any => .may

def scalar (p : Pattern) : Input :=
  let shape : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Shape :=
    match opHead p.head with | .exact => .exact | .star => .star | .may | .must => .any
  ⟨p.base,p.path,shape,p.mark,decide (opHead p.head = .must)⟩
def fromInput (i : Input) (e : List Acc := []) : Pattern := ⟨i.base,i.path,.plain (plainOf i),i.mark,e⟩
def erase (p : Pattern) : Pattern := {p with head := .plain (opHead p.head)}
def eraseFact (f : Fact) : Fact := {f with pattern := erase f.pattern}
def eraseSeed (s : Seed) : Seed := {s with pattern := erase s.pattern}

/-- A virtual MAY view must not walk into a field excluded by the original
STAR. Empty suffix is admitted. This is not an actual MAY/NORMAL data packet. -/
def originalReach (p : Pattern) (demandPath : List Acc) : Bool :=
  match dropPrefix p.path demandPath with
  | some (field :: _) => !decide (field ∈ p.exclusion)
  | _ => true

def provisionalFlowExactBlocked (d : Demand) (a : Input) : Bool :=
  RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq d.shape .exact &&
    (match d.mark with | .flow => true | _ => false) &&
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq a.shape .any && !a.must

/-- Current scalar cells with existing budget/direction/provisional FLOW guard.
Demand E is Empty. Actual known-step E is checked before either C2 view. -/
def oldCell (run : Nat) (mode : Mode) (d : Demand) (a : Pattern) : Option Pattern :=
  if decide (2 ≤ run ∧ d.path.length ≤ mode.fieldLimit ∧ a.path.length ≤ mode.fieldLimit) &&
      originalReach a d.path && !provisionalFlowExactBlocked d (scalar a) then
    let raw := if Nat.beq run 2 then RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emit d (scalar a)
      else RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d (scalar a)
    raw.bind fun i =>
      if MayInitialToStarAudit.directionLegal mode.direction i && decide (i.path.length ≤ mode.fieldLimit) then
        some (fromInput i (if i.must && decide (a.path = d.path) then a.exclusion else []))
      else none
  else none

/-- Mint only a formerly-MAY output. A STAR output inherits an input SOA
marker; an ordinary first-field STAR output never gains it. -/
def renderedHead (input : Head) (raw : PlainHead) : Head :=
  match raw with
  | .may => .starOrAny
  | .star => if marked input then .starOrAny else .plain .star
  | h => .plain h

def answer (input : Fact) (view raw : Pattern) : Seed :=
  let p := {raw with head := renderedHead input.pattern.head (opHead raw.head)}
  ⟨p,MayInitialToStarAudit.admissionLayer (scalar p) (scalar view) input.layer⟩
def starAnswer (run : Nat) (mode : Mode) (d : Demand) (a : Fact) : Option Seed :=
  (oldCell run mode d (erase a.pattern)).map (answer a (erase a.pattern))
def mayView (p : Pattern) : Pattern := {p with head := .plain .may,exclusion := []}
def mayAnswer (run : Nat) (mode : Mode) (d : Demand) (a : Fact) : Option Seed :=
  if marked a.pattern.head && originalReach a.pattern d.path then
    (oldCell run mode d (mayView a.pattern)).map (answer a (mayView a.pattern))
  else none

def combine (left right : Option Seed) : List Seed :=
  match left,right with
  | none,none => [] | some a,none => [a] | none,some b => [b]
  | some a,some b => if a = b then [a] else [a,b]

def c2 (choice : C2Choice) (run : Nat) (mode : Mode) (d : Demand) (a : Fact) : List Seed :=
  if !marked a.pattern.head then (starAnswer run mode d a).toList
  else match choice with
  | .mayOnly => (mayAnswer run mode d a).toList
  | .unionViews => combine (starAnswer run mode d a) (mayAnswer run mode d a)
  | .starThenMayForAny =>
      match starAnswer run mode d a with
      | some s => [s]
      | none => if RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq d.shape .any then (mayAnswer run mode d a).toList else []

structure Tag where
  old : OldTag
  decorate : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def materialize (tag : Tag) : Fact :=
  let old := SelectedFullAdmission.actualOf tag.old
  let p := fromInput old.fact
  ⟨{p with head := if tag.decorate && decide (opHead p.head = .star) then .starOrAny else p.head},old.layer,false⟩
def allTags : List Tag :=
  SelectedFullAdmission.allActualTags.flatMap fun old => [false,true].map fun flag => ⟨old,flag⟩
def rawImage (choice : C2Choice) (run : Nat) (mode : Mode) (d : Demand) : List Seed :=
  allTags.flatMap fun tag => c2 choice run mode d (materialize tag)
def canEmitRaw (choice : C2Choice) (run : Nat) (mode : Mode) (d : Demand) (seed : Seed) : Bool :=
  decide (seed ∈ rawImage choice run mode d)
def storedImage (choice : C2Choice) (run : Nat) (mode : Mode) (d : Demand) : List Seed :=
  (rawImage choice run mode d).map eraseSeed

/-- Operations keep STAR semantics and transport the decoration only along a
STAR-shaped result. Genuine EXACT/MAY/MUST results remove the marker. -/
def operationHead (input : Head) (output : PlainHead) : Head :=
  if decide (output = .star) && marked input then .starOrAny else .plain output

def applyStarSummary (entryBase resultBase : Nat) (entryPath resultPath : List Acc) (actual : Fact) : Option Fact :=
  if Nat.beq entryBase actual.pattern.base then
    (dropPrefix entryPath actual.pattern.path).map fun suffix =>
      { actual with
        pattern := { actual.pattern with
          base := resultBase
          path := resultPath ++ suffix
          head := operationHead actual.pattern.head (opHead actual.pattern.head) } }
  else none

inductive PublicPayload where
  | data (conclusion : Fact)
  | normalTarget (id : Nat)
  | demandTarget
  | pairedDemand (entry : Pattern) (exit : Option Pattern)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure PublicRow where
  premises : List Pattern
  payload : PublicPayload
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def erasePayload : PublicPayload → PublicPayload
  | .data f => .data (eraseFact f)
  | .normalTarget id => .normalTarget id
  | .demandTarget => .demandTarget
  | .pairedDemand entry exit => .pairedDemand (erase entry) (exit.map erase)
def normalizePublic (row : PublicRow) : PublicRow :=
  ⟨row.premises.map erase,erasePayload row.payload⟩
def allPlain : List Pattern → Bool | [] => true | x::xs => !marked x.head && allPlain xs
def payloadPlain : PublicPayload → Bool
  | .data f => !marked f.pattern.head
  | .pairedDemand e none => !marked e.head
  | .pairedDemand e (some x) => !marked e.head && !marked x.head
  | _ => true
def publicPlain (row : PublicRow) : Bool := allPlain row.premises && payloadPlain row.payload

/-- Archived NormalRuleContributorStore-like point inputs remain local inputs,
even across runs. They are not a public summary/demand boundary. -/
structure ArchivedPoint where
  owner : Nat
  scope : Nat
  point : Nat
  original : List Pattern
  actual : Fact
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
def archivePoint (row : ArchivedPoint) : ArchivedPoint := row

def f : Acc := 7
def g : Acc := 8
def T : Mark := .full 11
def mode : Mode := ⟨.forward,2⟩
def anyD (path : List Acc) (mark : Mark := .flow) : Demand := ⟨1,path,.any,mark⟩
def soa (path : List Acc) (mark : Mark := .flow) (e : List Acc := []) : Pattern := ⟨1,path,.starOrAny,mark,e⟩
def plainStar (path : List Acc) (mark : Mark := .flow) : Pattern := ⟨1,path,.plain .star,mark,[]⟩
def fact (p : Pattern) (layer : Layer := .normal) : Fact := ⟨p,layer,false⟩
def seed (p : Pattern) (layer : Layer := .normal) : Seed := ⟨p,layer⟩

theorem SOA_is_operational_STAR_not_uniform_MUST :
    opHead .starOrAny = .star ∧ opHead .starOrAny ≠ .must ∧
    scalar (soa []) = scalar (plainStar []) := by decide

theorem every_finite_actual_has_an_executable_tag (tag : Tag) : tag ∈ allTags := by
  cases tag with
  | mk old flag =>
    apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    refine ⟨old,SelectedFullAdmission.every_bounded_typed_actual_is_enumerated old,?_⟩
    apply List.mem_map.mpr
    exact ⟨flag,by cases flag <;> simp,rfl⟩

theorem exact_finite_raw_image_has_actual_witness
    (choice : C2Choice) (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (d : Demand) (s : Seed) :
    canEmitRaw choice run m d s = true ↔ ∃ tag : Tag, s ∈ c2 choice run m d (materialize tag) := by
  change decide (s ∈ allTags.flatMap (fun tag => c2 choice run m d (materialize tag))) = true ↔ _
  rw [decide_eq_true_eq,List.mem_flatMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨tag,_,member⟩; exact ⟨tag,member⟩
  · rintro ⟨tag,member⟩; exact ⟨tag,every_finite_actual_has_an_executable_tag tag,member⟩

theorem normalized_image_keeps_a_raw_constructor_preimage
    (choice : C2Choice) (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (d : Demand) (stored : Seed) :
    stored ∈ storedImage choice run m d ↔
      ∃ raw, raw ∈ rawImage choice run m d ∧ eraseSeed raw = stored := by
  exact List.mem_map

theorem common_wrapper_emits_decorated_STAR_with_current_layers :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (soa [])) = [seed (soa [])] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD [] T) (fact (soa [] T) .demand) = [seed (soa [] T) .demand] := by decide

theorem ordinary_STAR_same_head_ANY_rejection_is_unchanged :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (plainStar [])) = [] ∧
    c2 .mayOnly 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (plainStar [])) = [] ∧
    c2 .unionViews 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (plainStar [])) = [] := by decide

theorem draft_fallback_preserves_any_existing_STAR_answer
    (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (d : Demand) (a : Fact) (s : Seed)
    (soaInput : marked a.pattern.head = true) (oldAnswer : starAnswer run m d a = some s) :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny run m d a = [s] := by
  simp [c2,soaInput,oldAnswer]

theorem both_nonempty_common_views_have_compatible_seed_and_layer :
    starAnswer 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (soa [f,g])) = some (seed (soa [f])) ∧
    mayAnswer 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (soa [f,g])) = some (seed (soa [f])) ∧
    c2 .unionViews 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (soa [f,g])) = [seed (soa [f])] := by decide

theorem equal_two_view_answers_coalesce_without_layer_invention (s : Seed) :
    combine (some s) (some s) = [s] := by simp [combine]

/-- API-only negative cell. This demand is not proved reachable in the driver:
FLOW EXACT demand entries are excluded by current snapshot grammar. -/
theorem strict_MAY_only_can_drop_an_existing_API_STAR_admission :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode ⟨1,[],.exact,.flow⟩ (fact (soa [])) =
      [seed ⟨1,[],.plain .exact,.flow,[]⟩] ∧
    c2 .mayOnly 3 mode ⟨1,[],.exact,.flow⟩ (fact (soa [])) = [] := by decide

theorem original_STAR_exclusions_block_virtual_MAY_descents :
    mayAnswer 3 mode (anyD [f]) (fact (soa [] .flow [f])) = none ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD [f]) (fact (soa [] .flow [f])) = [] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD [g]) (fact (soa [] .flow [f])) = [seed (soa [g])] := by decide

theorem minimal_minting_and_first_field_inheritance :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact ⟨1,[],.plain .may,.flow,[]⟩ .demand) = [seed (soa [])] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact ⟨1,[f,g],.plain .may,.flow,[]⟩ .demand) = [seed (plainStar [f])] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (soa [f,g])) = [seed (soa [f])] := by decide

theorem deeper_C2_transition_needs_the_inherited_marker :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD [f]) (fact (soa [f])) = [seed (soa [f])] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD [f]) (fact (erase (soa [f]))) = [] := by decide

theorem genuine_nonSTAR_operation_or_cut_drops_the_marker :
    operationHead .starOrAny .star = .starOrAny ∧
    operationHead .starOrAny .exact = .plain .exact ∧
    operationHead .starOrAny .may = .plain .may ∧
    operationHead .starOrAny .must = .plain .must ∧
    operationHead (.plain .star) .star = .plain .star := by decide

theorem STAR_summary_application_preserves_SOAs_actual_suffix
    (b outBase : Nat) (entryPath resultPath suffix : List Acc) (mark : Mark)
    (layer : Layer) (e : List Acc) (h : Bool) :
    applyStarSummary b outBase entryPath resultPath
      ⟨⟨b,entryPath ++ suffix,.starOrAny,mark,e⟩,layer,h⟩ =
      some ⟨⟨outBase,resultPath ++ suffix,.starOrAny,mark,e⟩,layer,h⟩ := by
  have removed : dropPrefix entryPath (entryPath ++ suffix) = some suffix := CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
  simp [applyStarSummary,Nat.beq_refl,removed,operationHead,marked,opHead]

@[simp] theorem normalized_pattern_is_plain (p : Pattern) : marked (erase p).head = false := by
  cases p with
  | mk b path head mark e => cases head <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem normalized_pattern_is_idempotent (p : Pattern) : erase (erase p) = erase p := by
  cases p with
  | mk b path head mark e => cases head <;> rfl

theorem every_public_data_ND_Target_and_demand_slot_loses_the_marker (row : PublicRow) :
    publicPlain (normalizePublic row) = true := by
  have premises : allPlain (row.premises.map erase) = true := by
    induction row.premises with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons first rest ih => simp [allPlain,ih]
  cases row with
  | mk ps payload =>
    cases payload with
    | data f => simp [publicPlain,normalizePublic,erasePayload,payloadPlain,eraseFact,premises]
    | normalTarget id => simp [publicPlain,normalizePublic,erasePayload,payloadPlain,premises]
    | demandTarget => simp [publicPlain,normalizePublic,erasePayload,payloadPlain,premises]
    | pairedDemand entry exitValue =>
      cases exitValue <;> simp [publicPlain,normalizePublic,erasePayload,payloadPlain,premises]

theorem public_normalization_keeps_target_id_layer_and_protection (ps : List Pattern) (p : Pattern) (l : Layer) (h : Bool) (id : Nat) :
    (normalizePublic ⟨ps,.normalTarget id⟩).payload = .normalTarget id ∧
    (eraseFact ⟨p,l,h⟩).layer = l ∧ (eraseFact ⟨p,l,h⟩).protection = h := by
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

theorem archived_intra_proc_inputs_keep_the_capability (owner scope point : Nat) :
    (archivePoint ⟨owner,scope,point,[soa []],fact (soa [])⟩).actual.pattern.head = .starOrAny := rfl

theorem equal_location_view_does_not_allow_early_C2_erasure :
    scalar (erase (soa [])) = scalar (soa []) ∧
    soa [] ≠ erase (soa []) ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (soa [])) ≠
      c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (erase (soa []))) := by decide

theorem SOA_seed_has_normalized_STAR_preimage_not_ordinary_STAR_input_admission :
    eraseSeed (seed (soa [])) = seed (plainStar []) ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (soa [])) = [seed (soa [])] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (plainStar [])) = [] := by decide

/- Every counted-field path is allowed when it fits the unchanged budget.
The proof does not enumerate path length or the number of wrappers. -/
/-- This is the normalized entry-image part of C5, not restriction, insideDemand,
exit-side matching, budgets beyond oldCell, or actor publication. -/
theorem normalized_entry_image_has_an_explicit_actual_and_raw_joint_preimage
    (choice : C2Choice) (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (d : Demand) (stored : Seed) :
    stored ∈ storedImage choice run m d ↔
      ∃ tag : Tag, ∃ raw : Seed,
        raw ∈ c2 choice run m d (materialize tag) ∧ eraseSeed raw = stored := by
  rw [normalized_image_keeps_a_raw_constructor_preimage]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨raw,member,equal⟩
    change raw ∈ allTags.flatMap (fun tag => c2 choice run m d (materialize tag)) at member
    obtain ⟨tag,_,emitted⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp member
    exact ⟨tag,raw,emitted,equal⟩
  · rintro ⟨tag,raw,emitted,equal⟩
    refine ⟨raw,?_,equal⟩
    exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨tag,every_finite_actual_has_an_executable_tag tag,emitted⟩

theorem unrelated_EXACT_on_MAY_loss_and_normal_EXACT_support_are_unchanged :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode ⟨1,[],.exact,T⟩
      (fact ⟨1,[],.plain .may,T,[]⟩ .demand) =
        [seed ⟨1,[],.plain .exact,T,[]⟩ .demand] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode ⟨1,[],.exact,T⟩
      (fact ⟨1,[],.plain .exact,T,[]⟩) =
        [seed ⟨1,[],.plain .exact,T,[]⟩] := by decide

theorem marker_erasure_keeps_only_the_STAR_geometric_projection (p : Pattern) :
    scalar (erase p) = scalar p ∧ (erase p).exclusion = p.exclusion := by
  cases p with
  | mk b path head mark e => cases head <;> exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

def intrinsicMark : Mark → Layer | .flow => .normal | .full _ => .demand

def sameSOA (base : Nat) (path : List Acc) (mark : Mark) : Fact :=
  ⟨⟨base,path,.starOrAny,mark,[]⟩,intrinsicMark mark,false⟩

theorem same_head_ANY_admission_keeps_SOA_at_every_bounded_path
    (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (base : Nat) (path : List Acc) (mark : Mark)
    (restricted : 2 ≤ run) (bounded : path.length ≤ m.fieldLimit) :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny run m ⟨base,path,.any,mark⟩ (sameSOA base path mark) =
      [⟨⟨base,path,.starOrAny,mark,[]⟩,intrinsicMark mark⟩] := by
  have self : dropPrefix path path = some [] := ApSpec.Handoff.RAux.dropPrefix_self' path
  cases m with
  | mk direction limit =>
    cases direction <;> cases mark <;>
      simp [c2,starAnswer,mayAnswer,oldCell,sameSOA,erase,scalar,opHead,marked,
        mayView,originalReach,self,provisionalFlowExactBlocked,restricted,bounded,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emit,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.overrideStar,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit,RestrictedInitialPolicy.selectTemplate,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.rawTemplate,RestrictedInitialPolicy.validTemplate,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.validInput,RestrictedInitialPolicy.acceptsMark,
        RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq,RestrictedInitialPolicy.render,relate,
        MayInitialToStarAudit.directionLegal,fromInput,plainOf,answer,renderedHead,
        MayInitialToStarAudit.admissionLayer,MayInitialToStarAudit.intrinsic,
        MayInitialToStarAudit.layerOr,intrinsicMark]

/-- Model only physical copy bindings and the conditional STAR/FLOW summary.
No SOURCE, sink, branch, scheduling or loop semantics are added here. -/
def copyTo (base : Nat) (a : Fact) : Fact := {a with pattern := {a.pattern with base := base}}
def plainWrapper (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (a : Fact) : Option Fact :=
  let bound := copyTo 1 (copyTo 2 a)
  let d : Demand := ⟨bound.pattern.base,bound.pattern.path,.any,bound.pattern.mark⟩
  (c2 .starThenMayForAny run m d bound).head?.bind fun s =>
    applyStarSummary 1 1 s.pattern.path s.pattern.path ⟨s.pattern,s.layer,false⟩
def wrapperChain (run : Nat) (m : Mode) : Nat → Fact → Option Fact
  | 0,a => some a
  | n+1,a => (plainWrapper run m a).bind (wrapperChain run m n)

theorem one_plain_wrapper_copies_and_STAR_summary_preserve_the_capability
    (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (path : List Acc) (mark : Mark)
    (restricted : 2 ≤ run) (bounded : path.length ≤ m.fieldLimit) :
    plainWrapper run m (sameSOA 1 path mark) = some (sameSOA 1 path mark) := by
  have enter := same_head_ANY_admission_keeps_SOA_at_every_bounded_path run m 1 path mark restricted bounded
  have self : dropPrefix path path = some [] := ApSpec.Handoff.RAux.dropPrefix_self' path
  simpa [plainWrapper,copyTo,sameSOA,applyStarSummary,self,operationHead,marked,opHead] using
    congrArg (fun seeds : List Seed => seeds.head?.bind fun s =>
      applyStarSummary 1 1 s.pattern.path s.pattern.path ⟨s.pattern,s.layer,false⟩) enter

theorem any_number_of_plain_wrappers_preserves_local_admission_ability
    (n run : Nat) (m : Mode) (path : List Acc) (mark : Mark)
    (restricted : 2 ≤ run) (bounded : path.length ≤ m.fieldLimit) :
    wrapperChain run m n (sameSOA 1 path mark) = some (sameSOA 1 path mark) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [wrapperChain,
      one_plain_wrapper_copies_and_STAR_summary_preserve_the_capability run m path mark restricted bounded,
      Option.bind_some,ih]

def check : Bool :=
  decide (c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (soa [])) = [seed (soa [])]) &&
  decide (c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode (anyD []) (fact (plainStar [])) = []) &&
  decide (operationHead .starOrAny .may = .plain .may) &&
  publicPlain (normalizePublic ⟨[soa [],soa [] T],.data (fact (soa [f]))⟩)

theorem executable_draft_contract_cells : check = true := by decide

leanModel/StarOrAnyObligationsProofFixed.text:
/-
Local supplement to the checked STAR_OR_ANY model. No native adapter or global
progress claim. ND is conjunction of predicates on the STAR-geometric projection.
Certificate inputs are Empty-E MAY cuts at any earlier counted-field prefix.
Point storage has opaque DATA work and an exact separate SOA Fact frontier;
pattern (including E/mark), layer and literal protection are all in its key.
-/
import StarOrAnyDesignProofFixed

namespace StarOrAnyObligations
open ApSpec StarOrAnyDesign
abbrev Mark := StarOrAnyDesign.Mark
abbrev Pattern := StarOrAnyDesign.Pattern
abbrev Fact := StarOrAnyDesign.Fact
abbrev Seed := StarOrAnyDesign.Seed
abbrev Mode := StarOrAnyDesign.Mode
abbrev Layer := StarOrAnyDesign.Layer
abbrev Input := StarOrAnyDesign.Input
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

/-- Executable exact duplicate removal. It does not use prefix coverage. -/
def literalDedup {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | first :: rest => if first ∈ rest then literalDedup rest else first :: literalDedup rest

theorem exact_dedup_preserves_membership {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (value : α) (values : List α) : value ∈ literalDedup values ↔ value ∈ values := by
  induction values with
  | nil => simp [literalDedup]
  | cons first rest ih =>
    by_cases repeated : first ∈ rest
    · simp only [literalDedup,if_pos repeated,ih,List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · intro member; exact Or.inr member
      · intro member
        cases member with
        | inl same => cases same; exact repeated
        | inr member => exact member
    · simp only [literalDedup,if_neg repeated,List.mem_cons,ih]

/-- Predicates may inspect all STAR geometry, mark and E. They may not inspect
C2's live marker. This is the stated public ND interpretation. -/
def geometric {W : Type} (predicate : Input → List Acc → W → Prop)
    (p : Pattern) (w : W) : Prop := predicate (scalar p) p.exclusion w
def conjunction {W : Type} (predicate : Input → List Acc → W → Prop)
    (members : List Pattern) (w : W) : Prop :=
  ∀ p, p ∈ members → geometric predicate p w
def normalizeND (members : List Pattern) : List Pattern := literalDedup (members.map erase)

theorem normalized_ND_member_dedup_keeps_the_geometric_conjunction
    {W : Type} (predicate : Input → List Acc → W → Prop)
    (members : List Pattern) (w : W) :
    conjunction predicate (normalizeND members) w ↔ conjunction predicate members w := by
  have erased : ∀ p : Pattern, geometric predicate (erase p) w ↔ geometric predicate p w := by
    intro p
    unfold geometric
    rw [(marker_erasure_keeps_only_the_STAR_geometric_projection p).1,
      (marker_erasure_keeps_only_the_STAR_geometric_projection p).2]
  constructor
  · intro normalized p member
    apply (erased p).mp
    apply normalized (erase p)
    apply (exact_dedup_preserves_membership (erase p) (members.map erase)).mpr
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p,member,rfl⟩
  · intro original p member
    have mapped := (exact_dedup_preserves_membership p (members.map erase)).mp member
    obtain ⟨raw,inOriginal,same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mapped
    subst p
    exact (erased raw).mpr (original raw inOriginal)

/-- The prior scalar prefix lemma supplies the real old emission witness. The
new answer converts its MAY result to SOA and recalculates the current layer. -/
theorem earlier_MAY_prefix_cut_emits_the_same_SOA_joint_seed
    (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (b : Nat) (prefixPath suffix : List Acc)
    (required supplied : Mark)
    (restricted : 2 ≤ run)
    (markMatches : RestrictedInitialPolicy.acceptsMark required supplied = true)
    (budget : (prefixPath ++ suffix).length ≤ m.fieldLimit) :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny run m ⟨b,prefixPath ++ suffix,.any,required⟩
      ⟨fromInput (SelectedFullAdmission.mayAt b prefixPath supplied),.demand,false⟩ =
      [⟨⟨b,prefixPath ++ suffix,.starOrAny,required,[]⟩,intrinsicMark required⟩] := by
  let d : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand := ⟨b,prefixPath ++ suffix,.any,required⟩
  let actual : Input := SelectedFullAdmission.mayAt b prefixPath supplied
  let initial : Input := SelectedFullAdmission.mayAt b (prefixPath ++ suffix) required
  have prefixFits : prefixPath.length ≤ m.fieldLimit := by
    simp only [List.length_append] at budget
    omega
  have current : MayInitialToStarAudit.currentEmit m ⟨b,prefixPath ++ suffix,required⟩ actual = some initial :=
    SelectedFullAdmission.current_MAY_prefixes_emit_the_same_witness m b prefixPath suffix required supplied markMatches budget
  have boundedEmission : RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emitAtBudget m.fieldLimit d actual = some initial := by
    change (match RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emitAtBudget m.fieldLimit d actual with
      | none => none
      | some emitted => if MayInitialToStarAudit.directionLegal m.direction emitted then some emitted else none) = some initial at current
    cases observed : RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emitAtBudget m.fieldLimit d actual with
    | none =>
      simp only [observed] at current
      cases current
    | some candidate =>
      simp only [observed] at current
      cases legal : MayInitialToStarAudit.directionLegal m.direction candidate with
      | false =>
        simp only [legal,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false] at current
        cases current
      | true =>
        have same : candidate = initial := by
          simpa only [legal,if_true,Option.some.injEq] using current
        exact congrArg some same
  have selectedRaw : RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emit d actual = some initial :=
    (RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.budget_emission_facts m.fieldLimit d actual initial boundedEmission).2.2.1
  have noOverride : RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.overrideStar d actual = false := by
    simp [RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.overrideStar,d,RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq]
  have ordinaryRaw : RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d actual = some initial := by
    simpa only [RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emit,noOverride,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false] using selectedRaw
  have rawBoth : (if Nat.beq run 2 then RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.emit d actual
      else RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d actual) = some initial := by
    simp only [selectedRaw,ordinaryRaw,ite_self]
  have projected : scalar (fromInput actual) = actual := rfl
  have reachable : originalReach (fromInput actual) d.path = true := by
    unfold originalReach
    cases relation : dropPrefix (fromInput actual).path d.path with
    | none => rfl
    | some tail => cases tail <;> rfl
  have notBlocked : provisionalFlowExactBlocked d actual = false := rfl
  have valid : decide (2 ≤ run ∧ d.path.length ≤ m.fieldLimit ∧
      (fromInput actual).path.length ≤ m.fieldLimit) = true :=
    decide_eq_true ⟨restricted,budget,prefixFits⟩
  have legal : MayInitialToStarAudit.directionLegal m.direction initial = true := by
    cases m.direction <;> rfl
  have outputFits : decide (initial.path.length ≤ m.fieldLimit) = true := decide_eq_true budget
  have old : oldCell run m d (fromInput actual) = some (fromInput initial) := by
    unfold oldCell
    rw [projected,reachable,notBlocked,valid]
    simp only [Bool.true_and,Bool.not_false,if_true]
    rw [rawBoth]
    simp only [Option.bind_some,legal,outputFits,Bool.true_and,if_true]
    rfl
  have ordinaryBranch : c2 .starThenMayForAny run m d ⟨fromInput actual,.demand,false⟩ =
      ((oldCell run m d (fromInput actual)).map
        (answer ⟨fromInput actual,.demand,false⟩ (fromInput actual))).toList := rfl
  change c2 .starThenMayForAny run m d ⟨fromInput actual,.demand,false⟩ = _
  rw [ordinaryBranch,old]
  cases required <;> rfl

def certificateGuard (b : Nat) (path : List Acc) (mark : Mark) (s : Seed) : Bool :=
  decide (s.pattern = ⟨b,path,.starOrAny,mark,[]⟩ ∧ s.layer = intrinsicMark mark)
def labelSeeds (label : SelectedFullAdmission.Label) (seeds : List Seed) :
    List (SelectedFullAdmission.Label × Seed) := seeds.map (fun s => (label,s))

theorem certificate_keeps_complete_label_and_joint_answer_for_all_earlier_cuts
    (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (b : Nat) (path pre1 tail1 pre2 tail2 : List Acc)
    (required supplied : Mark) (label : SelectedFullAdmission.Label)
    (restricted : 2 ≤ run) (same1 : path = pre1 ++ tail1) (same2 : path = pre2 ++ tail2)
    (markMatches : RestrictedInitialPolicy.acceptsMark required supplied = true)
    (budget : path.length ≤ m.fieldLimit) :
    labelSeeds label (c2 .starThenMayForAny run m ⟨b,path,.any,required⟩
      ⟨fromInput (SelectedFullAdmission.mayAt b pre1 supplied),.demand,false⟩) =
    labelSeeds label (c2 .starThenMayForAny run m ⟨b,path,.any,required⟩
      ⟨fromInput (SelectedFullAdmission.mayAt b pre2 supplied),.demand,false⟩) ∧
    certificateGuard b path required ⟨⟨b,path,.starOrAny,required,[]⟩,intrinsicMark required⟩ = true := by
  have first := earlier_MAY_prefix_cut_emits_the_same_SOA_joint_seed run m b pre1 tail1 required supplied
    restricted markMatches (by simpa only [← same1] using budget)
  have second := earlier_MAY_prefix_cut_emits_the_same_SOA_joint_seed run m b pre2 tail2 required supplied
    restricted markMatches (by simpa only [← same2] using budget)
  rw [← same1] at first
  rw [← same2] at second
  exact ⟨by rw [first,second],by simp [certificateGuard]⟩

/-- DATA canonicalization is an input parameter, not a new DATA law. The literal
capability frontier is independent of its prefix coverage choices. -/
structure Point where
  dataRows : List Fact
  capabilityRows : List Fact
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def isCapability (a : Fact) : Bool := marked a.pattern.head
def canonicalPoint (dataCanonical : List Fact → List Fact) (offered : List Fact) : Point :=
  ⟨dataCanonical (offered.map eraseFact),
    literalDedup (offered.filter isCapability)⟩
def guideEffect (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (d : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand)
    (offered : List Fact) (s : Seed) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, a ∈ offered ∧ isCapability a = true ∧ s ∈ c2 .starThenMayForAny run m d a
def retainedEffect (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (d : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand)
    (point : Point) (s : Seed) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, a ∈ point.capabilityRows ∧ s ∈ c2 .starThenMayForAny run m d a

theorem point_keeps_exact_pattern_layer_and_literal_H_coordinates
    (dataCanonical : List Fact → List Fact) (offered : List Fact) (a : Fact) :
    a ∈ (canonicalPoint dataCanonical offered).capabilityRows ↔
      a ∈ offered ∧ isCapability a = true := by
  change a ∈ literalDedup (offered.filter isCapability) ↔ _
  rw [exact_dedup_preserves_membership,List.mem_filter]

theorem capability_membership_is_independent_of_both_arrival_orders_and_duplicates
    (dataCanonical : List Fact → List Fact) (left right : List Fact) (a : Fact) :
    (a ∈ (canonicalPoint dataCanonical (left ++ right)).capabilityRows ↔
      a ∈ (canonicalPoint dataCanonical (right ++ left)).capabilityRows) ∧
    (a ∈ (canonicalPoint dataCanonical (left ++ left)).capabilityRows ↔
      a ∈ (canonicalPoint dataCanonical left).capabilityRows) := by
  simp only [point_keeps_exact_pattern_layer_and_literal_H_coordinates,List.mem_append,or_self]
  exact ⟨by rw [or_comm],True.intro⟩

theorem opaque_DATA_canonicalization_preserves_every_supplied_SOA_C2_effect
    (dataCanonical : List Fact → List Fact) (offered : List Fact)
    (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (d : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand) (s : Seed) :
    retainedEffect run m d (canonicalPoint dataCanonical offered) s ↔ guideEffect run m d offered s := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,member,emitted⟩
    obtain ⟨original,capability⟩ :=
      (point_keeps_exact_pattern_layer_and_literal_H_coordinates dataCanonical offered a).mp member
    exact ⟨a,original,capability,emitted⟩
  · rintro ⟨a,member,capability,emitted⟩
    exact ⟨a,(point_keeps_exact_pattern_layer_and_literal_H_coordinates dataCanonical offered a).mpr
      ⟨member,capability⟩,emitted⟩

    (run : Nat) (m : Mode) (d : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand) (s : Seed) :
    retainedEffect run m d (canonicalPoint dataCanonical (left ++ right)) s ↔
      retainedEffect run m d (canonicalPoint dataCanonical (right ++ left)) s := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,member,emitted⟩
    exact ⟨a,(capability_membership_is_independent_of_both_arrival_orders_and_duplicates
      dataCanonical left right a).1.mp member,emitted⟩
  · rintro ⟨a,member,emitted⟩
    exact ⟨a,(capability_membership_is_independent_of_both_arrival_orders_and_duplicates
      dataCanonical left right a).1.mpr member,emitted⟩

    let p := soa []
    let n : Fact := ⟨p,.normal,false⟩

    let demand : Fact := ⟨p,.demand,false⟩
    n ≠ protectedN ∧ n ≠ demand ∧
    (canonicalPoint (fun _ => []) [n,protectedN,demand]).capabilityRows = [n,protectedN,demand] := by decide
