leanModel/PublicDemandHandoffCounterexam.text:
/-
Local public-handoff counterexample; no repair is selected here.
Use the checked new C2/normalizer. Raw singleton concrete DATA P/C use SOA,
DEMAND and Empty E. Public normalization erases SOA. Backward-to-forward
handoff reverses C/P into demand entry/exit; layer D selects this row.
Next run3 has an ordinary child EXACT/T NORMAL actual. STAR demand rejects it;
the old MAY demand admits terminal child EXACT/T NORMAL. All paths fit budget.
This is a next-C2 image difference, not a whole-program/global soundness proof.
-/
import StarOrAnyDesignProofFixed

namespace StarOrAnyPublicHandoff
open ApSpec StarOrAnyDesign
abbrev Mark := StarOrAnyDesign.Mark
abbrev Pattern := StarOrAnyDesign.Pattern
abbrev Fact := StarOrAnyDesign.Fact
abbrev Seed := StarOrAnyDesign.Seed
abbrev Demand := StarOrAnyDesign.Demand

/-- Base1 is the argument; base2 is the return. These are symbolic ordinary
bases, not recorded Java variables, physical ports or injected runtime rows. -/
def argumentSOA : Pattern := ⟨1,[],.starOrAny,T,[]⟩
def returnSOA : Pattern := ⟨2,[],.starOrAny,T,[]⟩
def argumentSTAR : Pattern := erase argumentSOA
def returnSTAR : Pattern := erase returnSOA
def argumentMAY : Pattern := ⟨1,[],.plain .may,T,[]⟩
def returnMAY : Pattern := ⟨2,[],.plain .may,T,[]⟩
def rawSOARow : PublicRow := ⟨[returnSOA],.data ⟨argumentSOA,.demand,false⟩⟩
def normalizedSOARow : PublicRow := normalizePublic rawSOARow
def oldMAYRow : PublicRow := ⟨[returnMAY],.data ⟨argumentMAY,.demand,false⟩⟩
def childEXACT : Fact := ⟨⟨1,[f],.plain .exact,T,[]⟩,.normal,false⟩
def childSeed : Seed := ⟨childEXACT.pattern,.normal⟩
def rootSTAR : Demand := ⟨1,[],.star,T⟩
def rootMAY : Demand := ⟨1,[],.any,T⟩

structure Pair where
  entry : Pattern
  exit : Pattern
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Singleton concrete DATA case of backward HandOff.toForward. D is sufficient
for selectedForHandoff. Other selectors/ND/control/static/ownership are open. -/
def backwardHandoff (row : PublicRow) : List Pair :=
  match row.premises,row.payload with
  | [p],.data conclusion => if conclusion.layer = .demand then [⟨conclusion.pattern,p⟩] else []
  | _,_ => []
def asC2Demand (p : Pattern) : Demand :=
  let geometric := scalar p
  ⟨geometric.base,geometric.path,geometric.shape,geometric.mark⟩
def handoffAdmissions (run : Nat) (row : PublicRow) (actual : Fact) : List Seed :=
  (backwardHandoff row).flatMap fun pair => c2 .starThenMayForAny run mode (asC2Demand pair.entry) actual

theorem public_normalization_erases_both_concrete_slots_but_keeps_DEMAND :
    normalizedSOARow = ⟨[returnSTAR],.data ⟨argumentSTAR,.demand,false⟩⟩ ∧
    scalar argumentSOA = scalar argumentSTAR ∧
    (normalizePublic rawSOARow).premises = [returnSTAR] := by decide

theorem selected_backward_handoff_retains_the_STAR_entry_and_paired_exit :
    backwardHandoff normalizedSOARow = [⟨argumentSTAR,returnSTAR⟩] ∧
    asC2Demand argumentSTAR = rootSTAR ∧
    backwardHandoff oldMAYRow = [⟨argumentMAY,returnMAY⟩] ∧
    asC2Demand argumentMAY = rootMAY := by decide

theorem ordinary_run3_STAR_demand_rejects_child_EXACT_while_MAY_admits_it :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode rootSTAR childEXACT = [] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode rootMAY childEXACT = [childSeed] ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit rootSTAR (scalar childEXACT.pattern) = none ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit rootMAY (scalar childEXACT.pattern) =
      some (scalar childEXACT.pattern) := by decide

theorem normalized_public_handoff_changes_the_next_joint_admission_image :
    handoffAdmissions 3 normalizedSOARow childEXACT = [] ∧
    handoffAdmissions 3 oldMAYRow childEXACT = [childSeed] := by decide

theorem new_concrete_initial_stays_DEMAND_before_public_erasure :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode rootMAY ⟨argumentMAY,.demand,false⟩ =
      [⟨argumentSOA,.demand⟩] ∧
    eraseSeed ⟨argumentSOA,.demand⟩ = ⟨argumentSTAR,.demand⟩ := by decide

theorem same_head_and_run2_controls_do_not_repair_the_run3_descendant_cell :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode rootSTAR
      ⟨⟨1,[],.plain .exact,T,[]⟩,.normal,false⟩ =
      [⟨⟨1,[],.plain .exact,T,[]⟩,.normal⟩] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 2 ⟨.backward,2⟩ rootSTAR childEXACT =
      [⟨argumentSTAR,.demand⟩] ∧
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 3 mode rootSTAR childEXACT = [] := by decide

theorem the_lost_next_admission_has_an_explicit_ordinary_actual_witness :
    ∃ actual : Fact, actual = childEXACT ∧
      handoffAdmissions 3 oldMAYRow actual = [childSeed] ∧
      handoffAdmissions 3 normalizedSOARow actual = [] := by
  exact ⟨childEXACT,rfl,by decide,by decide⟩

def check : Bool :=
  decide (handoffAdmissions 3 normalizedSOARow childEXACT = []) &&
  decide (handoffAdmissions 3 oldMAYRow childEXACT = [childSeed]) &&
  decide (childEXACT.layer = .normal) &&
  decide (childEXACT.pattern.path.length ≤ mode.fieldLimit) &&
  decide (asC2Demand argumentSTAR = rootSTAR)

theorem executable_handoff_counterexample : check = true := by decide
#eval (if check then "SOA_PUBLIC_HANDOFF_COUNTEREXAMPLE=true" else "SOA_PUBLIC_HANDOFF_COUNTEREXAMPLE=false")

#print axioms public_normalization_erases_both_concrete_slots_but_keeps_DEMAND
#print axioms selected_backward_handoff_retains_the_STAR_entry_and_paired_exit
#print axioms ordinary_run3_STAR_demand_rejects_child_EXACT_while_MAY_admits_it
#print axioms normalized_public_handoff_changes_the_next_joint_admission_image
#print axioms new_concrete_initial_stays_DEMAND_before_public_erasure
#print axioms same_head_and_run2_controls_do_not_repair_the_run3_descendant_cell
#print axioms the_lost_next_admission_has_an_explicit_ordinary_actual_witness
#print axioms executable_handoff_counterexample

end StarOrAnyPublicHandoff

portableProofChecker.text:
"""Check the portable, constructive local STAR_OR_ANY model. No native jobs."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LEAN = HERE.parent.parent
MODULES = [
    ('RestrictedInitialPolicy', '3a42cc1eb3209c82400ba528bdb1e80ba17bc09540e19e59b0d5272f9fd7c5f0'),
    ('MayInitialToStarAuditRootChecked', 'afe6f23f44a937bda291f0444476737e418a1fee574d597b9cb3cf7bbdb6a0c4'),
    ('SelectedFullAdmissionProofFixed', 'c8e7c2bd1c79039991f2918ca4cbccca88b7787a25261d414704373af987785b'),
    ('StarOrAnyDesignProofFixed', '705d2f474e039c517f8f33b4e7ffdec5af6436bd590e437a0df56392b4e4442c'),
    ('StarOrAnyObligationsProofFixed', 'b63650cb76f437b668028a42f93b50b00a30130c857d73c7fbb3f4bd575a1cb2'),
    ('PublicDemandHandoffCounterexample', 'ecb79a5ddda53f35de7c086bd20d679303c387eb26cc98a00d06a2e3f50317e1'),
]

def check_pins():
    for module, expected in MODULES:
        assert hashlib.sha256((HERE / (module + '.lean')).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, module

check_pins()
outputs = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='portable-star-or-any-') as directory:
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env['LEAN_PATH'] = directory + os.pathsep + env.get('LEAN_PATH', '')
    for module, _ in MODULES:
        source = HERE / (module + '.lean')
        code = re.sub(r'/\-.*?\-/', '', source.read_text(), flags=re.S)
        code = re.sub(r'--[^\n]*', '', code)
        assert not re.search(r'^\s*(?:axiom|opaque|noncomputable)\b|\b(?:sorry|admit|Classical)\b', code, re.M)
        result = subprocess.run(
            ['lake', 'env', 'lean', '--root=' + str(HERE), '-M2048',
             '-o', str(Path(directory) / (module + '.olean')), str(source)],
            cwd=LEAN, env=env, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        )
        print(result.stdout, end='', flush=True)
        assert result.returncode == 0 and 'error:' not in result.stdout and 'sorryAx' not in result.stdout, module
        outputs.append(result.stdout)

check_pins()
audits = []
for name, dependencies in re.findall(
    r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms:\s*\[([^]]*)\]", '\n'.join(outputs), re.S
):
    used = sorted(filter(None, dependencies.replace('\n', '').replace(' ', '').split(',')))
    assert set(used) <= {'propext', 'Quot.sound'}, (name, used)
    audits.append(dict(theorem=name, axioms=used))
for name in re.findall(r"'([^']+)' does not depend on any axioms", '\n'.join(outputs)):
    audits.append(dict(theorem=name, axioms=[]))
groups = [
    ('StarOrAnyDesignProofFixed', 'StarOrAnyDesign', 29, 'STAR_OR_ANY_DESIGN'),
    ('StarOrAnyObligationsProofFixed', 'StarOrAnyObligations', 10, 'STAR_OR_ANY_OBLIGATIONS'),
]
counterexample_groups = [
    ('PublicDemandHandoffCounterexample', 'StarOrAnyPublicHandoff', 8, 'SOA_PUBLIC_HANDOFF_COUNTEREXAMPLE'),
]
selected = []
counterexamples = []
for module, namespace, count, marker in groups + counterexample_groups:
    source = (HERE / (module + '.lean')).read_text()
    names = re.findall(r'^(?:@\[simp\] )?theorem (\w+)', source, re.M)
    assert len(names) == count and len(set(names)) == count
    assert names == re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\w+)', source, re.M)
    group = [item for item in audits if item['theorem'].startswith(namespace + '.')]
    assert len(group) == count
    assert {item['theorem'] for item in group} == {namespace + '.' + name for name in names}
    output = outputs[[name for name, _ in MODULES].index(module)]
    assert marker + '=true' in output and marker + '=false' not in output
    if namespace == 'StarOrAnyPublicHandoff':
        counterexamples.extend(group)
    else:
        selected.extend(group)
assert len(selected) == 39 and len(counterexamples) == 8
print(json.dumps(dict(
    state='PASS_LOCAL_STAR_OR_ANY_AND_PUBLIC_HANDOFF_COUNTEREXAMPLE', checkedNewLaws=39,
    checkedCounterexampleLaws=8, totalAuditedLaws=47,
    checkedLawGroups={namespace: count for _, namespace, count, _ in groups},
    counterexampleLawGroups={namespace: count for _, namespace, count, _ in counterexample_groups},
    modelPins=dict(MODULES), newLawAxiomAudit=selected,
    counterexampleAxiomAudit=counterexamples,
    scope=['Finite ordinary counted-field template image; STAR geometry/erasure; local marker transport and arbitrary wrapper-count induction.',
           'Normalized ND-member deduplication preserves conjunction of STAR-geometric predicates.',
           'Every bounded earlier Empty-E MAY cut gives the same SOA joint seed/layer and unchanged complete label.',
           'A separate literal pattern/layer/H capability frontier preserves supplied SOA C2 effects in both arrival orders, independent of opaque DATA work.'],
    counterexampleScope='Singleton concrete SOA/DEMAND publication normalizes both P/C to STAR; backward-to-forward handoff then rejects a run-3 child EXACT/NORMAL actual that the old MAY demand admits.',
    counterexampleIsPolicyRepair=False, globalSoundnessProved=False,
    notProved=['Native adapter equivalence and full legal-input completeness',
               'Arbitrary static/GROUP/mx/E/noncounted/ZERO adapters',
               'Complete C5 and native ND/Target boundary adapters',
               'Native loop trial/certificate equality and packed/scalar point freshness',
               'Producer arrival, mixed-header adapters and whole-pipeline capability transport',
               'Whole-program recovery, global source/sink soundness, progress or project performance'],
), indent=2))

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.driver.FixedLimits
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.Target
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.DriverFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.BlockScope
import org.opentaint.dataflow.graph.BlockId
import org.opentaint.dataflow.graph.PortId
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallPoint.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.StageKind.*
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

class StarOrAnyDeepLoopTraceTest {
    @Test fun `exceptional ZERO normal demand keeps a four field source through the fifth run`() {
        DriverFixtures().use { f ->
            val p = f.program
            // while(true) { sourceAtFFFF(x); x=x.f; sinkRootT(x); }
            val b = p.method("deep-loop-no-leave", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3),
                listOf(4), listOf(5), listOf(2), emptyList(), emptyList()),
                normalExit = 6, exceptionalExit = 7, backwardExitDiscovery = true).key()
            val arg = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
            val x = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
            val field = p.field("f")
            val t = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("T"))
            p.statement(b, 1, MicroEdgeBuilder().apply { move(x, arg) }.build())
            val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(x, List(4) { field }, Tail.EXACT, t), ExclusionSet.Empty)
            fun plan(sourceCall: Boolean, sinks: List<SinkRule> = emptyList()) = CallPlan(setOf(x), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(keepEdge(x), ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, if (sourceCall) SOURCES else UNRESOLVED,
                    if (sourceCall) f.summary(keepEdge(x), ZERO_KEEP, source) else f.summary(keepEdge(x), ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(keepEdge(x), ZERO_KEEP))
            ), sinks, BEFORE, AFTER)
            p.call(b, 3, plan(sourceCall = true))
            p.statement(b, 4, MicroEdgeBuilder().apply { read(x, x, listOf(field)) }.build())
            val sink = SinkRule(f.rule("deep-loop-root-sink"), 0, listOf(p.pattern(x, mark = t)), emptyList())
            p.call(b, 5, plan(sourceCall = false, sinks = listOf(sink)))
            val result = f.driver(FixedLimits(listOf(1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)), 15.seconds,
                run1MarkMode = MarkMode.FULL).analyze(listOf(b))
            for (run in f.results) {
                println("TRACE_RUN ${run.runIndex} ${run.status}")
                for (actor in run.analyzers) {
                    println("TRACE_STATS ${run.runIndex} ${actor.blockDiagnostics()}")
                    for ((pr, fs) in actor.summaries.all()) println("TRACE_ROOT ${run.runIndex} ${pr.members.map { it.toPattern() }} -> ${fs.layer} ${f.ops.leaves(fs).toList()}")
                    for (block in actor.blockSummaries()) for ((pr, fs) in block.summaries.all()) println("TRACE_BLOCK ${run.runIndex} $block ${pr.members.map { it.toPattern() }} -> ${fs.layer} ${f.ops.leaves(fs).toList()}")
                    for (target in actor.targets) println("TRACE_TARGET ${run.runIndex} ${target.premise.members.map { it.toPattern() }} -> ${target.target}")
                }
            }
            val fifthConfig = f.configs.single { it.index == 5 }
